Title: Transient Windows file lock during state write
Reproduction Steps: Concurrent writes while antivirus scanner or indexer holds open read handle
Root Cause: Windows NTFS file lock prevented immediate renameSync without retry
Remediation Applied: Added collision-proof temp naming and 5-attempt bounded retry with busy-wait jitter

Title: Direct URL navigation and refresh on /user-manual returned 404
Reproduction Steps: Navigate directly to http://localhost:3787/user-manual or refresh page
Root Cause: server.js only served index.html on root / and /index.html
Remediation Applied: Added /user-manual /help /manual to server SPA fallback list

Title: DCF test suite lacked explicit metamorphic property assertions
Root Cause: DCF suite had benchmark and boundary tests but not parameterized metamorphic verification
Remediation Applied: Added Test 13 in test/dcf.test.js asserting EV/growth EV/WACC cash debt shares and price properties

Title: DCF WACC and terminal growth silent clamping in prior versions
Reproduction Steps: Enter WACC <= g in DCF input parameters
Root Cause: Engine silently clamped effective WACC = max(WACC terminalGrowth + 0.005)
Remediation Applied: Replaced silent clamping with strict mathematical warning and null intrinsic value in invalid sensitivity cells

Title: Shares source tracking was not persisted across DCF render passes
Reproduction Steps: Invoke DCF on equity with estimated shares
Root Cause: sharesSource string was not forwarded through context in all UI renders
Remediation Applied: Added explicit sharesSource and note derivation across server and client
